clues: This town sits on the coast of Borneo, a huge island in Southeast Asia. It lies in the mid part of Sarawak, by the sea.
Two monsoon seasons take turns here across the year. Rain peaks in January on the coast, then eases off by the dry mid year months.
In eighteen sixty seven, the first General Council met here. It was the earliest state law making system in the whole country.
This place stayed a small fishing village until nineteen sixty nine. Then oil and gas were found off its coast, and big fuel plants rose.
Each year, an international kite festival fills the sky over this town. Bright kites soar and dip above its streets and shore.
